content:
**PinkGorge batch complete — 8 beads closed, all committed, suite 338 passed / 0 failed / 3 ignored.**

| Bead | Commit | Change |
|---|---|---|
| cg6.1 | 820e333 | escalation state machine into notify_blocked leaf (replay determinism) |
| l4s.1 | 0856f8a | per-project loops sidecars + legacy migration (killed shared-file lost-update) |
| cg6.2 | 5827e37 | leaf errors never abort the loop (soft-fail policy, 14-leaf sweep) |
| l4s.2 | 5827e37 | read failures propagate, never clobber (+v1 audit restored) |
| cg6.4 | 2975851 | FailStop message/doc state real 4-failure threshold |
| cg6.3 | 5900bb2 | replay-idempotent respawn (`--force` carve-out) / xproj marker / notify tier-gate |
| cg6.5 | cad512c | three-state send records — timeouts never re-sent on resume |
| is1.4 | 47918bf | checkpointed leaf logging (no replay-dupe JSONL) + quiet idle renew |

Notes for the swarm:
- **state.rs API additions** (sidecar era): `remove_active_loop`, `xproj_seen_*` markers, `EscalationState.last_ping_tier` — l4s.3/193.2 consumers take note.
- **main.rs `__respawn`** now takes `--force` (context_limit carve-out) + healthy-exists guard.
- cg6.3's at-least-once policy is documented in durable.rs module docs (all 4 side-effecting leaves).
- Coordination was clean after the region-split mail (config.rs socket fix + cron atomic fix from MistyDesert unblocked my gate promptly).
- Remaining ready: c3b.2 (big &self refactor — untouched), is1.1/1.2/1.3/1.5, 193.3, se2.3 (WAIT — defer until toron R1).
